title: Inside Attention/FFN Disaggregation
snippet: A deep dive into attention/FFN disaggregation for LLM inference: why splitting the attention and feed-forward stages across distinct GPU pools improves throughput and hardware utilization, how KV-cache transfer and all-to-all dispatch/combine bandwidth constrain the design, and how MegaScale-Infer and Step-3 style deployments realize prefill/decode plus layer-level disaggregation in production serving systems.
